# ex: needParen wraps binary expression in higher-precedence contexts
ex {
	var x int
	var y int
	x * y -> x + y
}
-- x.go --
package p

func f(a, b, c int) {
	// BinaryExpr outer: (a*b) * c -> (a+b) * c needs parens
	_ = a*b * c
	// selector: (a*b).x is not possible for int, skip
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,6 +2,6 @@

 func f(a, b, c int) {
 	// BinaryExpr outer: (a*b) * c -> (a+b) * c needs parens
-	_ = a*b * c
+	_ = (a + b) + c
 	// selector: (a*b).x is not possible for int, skip
 }
